findings.detail: The spec places before-project/JSON/SDK validation in static_v4_bootstrap, while Task3 only requires a validated ticket before real preparation effects and exposes prepare_v4(ticket). Direct python -m preparation or ordinary import executes module top-level code before that callable can validate a ticket. The no-generic-CLI-bypass statement does not specify an inert module top level, an audited pre-import guard on direct routes, or a test that direct -m/import refuses before JSON/SDK imports and output. Thus an implementation can satisfy the listed callable tests yet retain the earlier import-before-admission route.
findings.requested_change: Specify and test an inert preauthorization top level for preparation and any effectful study entry; direct CLI/import must fail or remain inert before JSON/project/SDK imports, output, or child/query effects. Define how the primitive validated ticket is bound to the later callable, without a truthy/caller-made dict serving as authorization. Add direct-route before-import/effect refusal coverage with inert protocols.
